documents.unit: Center for Excellence in Teaching and Learning (CETL)
documents.title: CETL Syllabus Template (includes Use of Generative Artificial Intelligence section)
documents.quality_note: Official CETL template; AI section is a policy statement plus sample language within a long syllabus template.

notes: No standalone university-wide AI policy found; press and the AI Task Force page say the decision is left to instructors and the Task Force was to write guidance for the Provost. Policy directory (policies.olemiss.edu) academic-conduct text does not mention AI. No CIS department or School of Engineering AI policy found. CETL blog posts and the Academic Innovations Group task-force page were fetched but excluded as news or generic. Third-party aggregator (trinka.ai) not collected.
